label: baseline-b

fixturePolicy.musicTime: 25 s; broadcast 5 s; advances 1/60 s per measured step
fixturePolicy.audio: real engine created, note scheduler disabled, synthetic performance clock
fixturePolicy.mainAnimation: real frame function with controlled camera/time
fixturePolicy.included: musicians, audience, venue, selected effects/worlds, shadows, selected broadcast, post processing
fixturePolicy.effectsPeak: two immediate confetti bursts, three immediate fireworks bursts, ten 1/60 s settling updates; lighting rig still entering; no delayed finale timers
fixturePolicy.effectsShow: warm only lasers and wash for 480 x 1/60 s at t=12..20 before the same immediate bursts and ten settling updates; active beams
fixturePolicy.domeReadiness: wait for existing UI readiness and visible dome; observe actual main-camera dome draws only during the unchanged warmup; restore hooks and check program readiness/link outside measured samples; hidden dome invalidates a step
